review_description: Absolute pleasure to find somebody who provides straight answers, honest advice and is always available to answer questions. The system we installed was a 48 kW Sigenergy system linked to our existing system. Erol and his team of staff were professional and installed the system at a price point below many of the larger installers that quoted more for the same system.

How was the sales/quoting process?Sales quoting process was excellent and offered a variety of optionsHow did the installation go? Polite? Tidy? Punctual?Installation was spot on. Cleaned up the site and turned up as plannedHow was the customer service? e.g. did they help organise the grid connection after the install, or show you how to use the charger?Excellent. got taken through the entire system, the app and advice

I recently had a solar system with battery installed by Energy Trade Solutions, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. From start to finish, the entire process was smooth and hassle-free. Quotes were promptly sent with all details on them.The communication throughout was excellent—clear, timely, and professional. Every question I had was answered promptly, which gave me confidence in the project.The installers were extremely knowledgeable and demonstrated a high level of expertise. They explained everything in detail and ensured the system was set up perfectly.Overall, Energy Trade Solutions delivered a seamless experience from beginning to end. I highly recommend them to anyone considering a solar and battery solution.
A very professional outfit. Knowledgable, helpful and polite. As good as it gets. Highly recommend !!

The team we had here were awesome. Really appreciate the professionalism. So refreshing. The quality of the work and products we are happy with as well. The solar panels look great and the battery install very happy with how it looks.Can only say great things.

Energy Trade solutions recently completed the solar install at my brand-new home. The quality of the work, installation, attention to detail and overall team was above and beyond with their professionalism and expertise. Anything I needed, all minor detailed requests were catered for with a smile and willingness to help. Thank you guys!!

We’ve just had a 16kwh sigenergy battery system + 4.3kw Aiko solar expansion added to our existing Enphase system. I had various quotes done with multiple companies, NG were by far the most reasonable and most thorough even at the quoting stage. I could tell that they had a wealth of knowledge and experience within the industry.The final install product was exceptional and exactly what we had asked for!The entire team was fantastic to deal with throughout the whole process. Brenton, Dylan and crew who installed on site were extremely professional and took pride in their work to ensure the end product was perfect!A great genuine company to deal with would highly recommend!

NG Trade Solutions did a fantastic job installing my solar and battery system. The team was friendly, helpful, and professional throughout the whole process. They answered all my questions before, during and after installation, they were always just an email or call away.The quality of their work is excellent, and the system looks and performs great. On top of that, they offered great value for money — top-quality installation at a fair price.I’m extremely happy with the result and would highly recommend NG Trade Solutions to anyone considering solar or battery installation.

We received quotes from Erol at NG Trade Solutions that matched our budget, we had our questions answered and the job booked in and completed in a timely manner. Lanie gave us updates and communicated the process well.The sparkies were polite and professional with the install and everything was connected and working flawlessly in no time.

Erol/Lanie and the guys were great. After talking to 5 different installers, I chose NG. Very professional, very easy to deal with. I would definitely use these guys again. The SIG system is very nice as well.

Very pleased with the service provided by NG Trade Solutions. Both Erol and Lanie have been on-hand to answer any queries throughout the process. We went with a Sigenergy battery paired with AIKO panels on their recommendation and couldn't be happier. They provided the best quote of the multiple vendors we contacted, no haggling needed.Installation went smoothly, all done in a day (10hrs approx.), the team of installers were friendly and knowledgeable, flagged everything they weren't sure about to get my approval. They also ran me through the basics of using the system and answered queries we had about ongoing maintenance. Will be recommending to family and friends.
Great customer service - communication was great throughout the process. Installation was very professional with high quality workmanship
Great experience with these guys. They were one of the cheapest so I was a little hesitant at first but they've been awesome to deal with.

The sales/quoting process was good. Very competitive. Installation was outstanding, listened to my requests and problem solved fantastically.  Got to keep my inverter when everyone else said otherwise. Polite and tidy and punctual.  Very nice professional install.Customer service was OK, they did help organise the rebate, grid connection after the install, and showed me the app you how to use the charger?   Customer service was lacking, with a very late battery (out of their control) but no feedback, I had to chase them up many, many times.Would definitely recommend. After installation support has been good.

Quoting was prompt. Friendly. Unfortunately shipping hold up delayed installation, but communicated well from NG.No issues and very happy with installation.Clean crew, very courteous, on time, met promises, tidied up a few other issues as they were going.

Was a great instal, crew were very courteous and accommodating. Arrived on time and completed job within stated time. Cleaned up following install and removed all rubbish, excellent job! System operation was explained to me including how to use app on my phone. Definitely 5 star review.

The quoting process was very punctual and the follow up of when the system would likely be installed.Very efficient tradesmen who never stopped until the job was completed. Included replacing some roof tiles to the other side of the roof and sealing from water.After completion we were shown how the system worked including downloading the app on our internet and how to read it.I would strongly recommend this company for solar or battery ionstallation.

As previously reviewed, NG Trade Solutions recently installed a 13kw Aiko solar array as well as a Sigenergy gateway and inverter, with the plan to install batteries pending the outcome of the federal battery rebate.Yesterday Erols team arrived as planned and on time, ready to efficiently upgrade the system with 32kwh of Sigenstor batteries. This has been an ongoing discussion with Erol as I have changed my mind a few times on capacity (originally planned for 16, then 24 kwh) however nothing was ever a problem and changes were easily and immediately accommodated for.I'd recommend NG Trade Solutions to anyone looking to install solar and batteries within their area of operation for a refreshingly easy, respectful and professional experience.

We recently had the pleasure of working with NG Energy Trade Solutions for the installation of our home battery storage system, and we must say, the entire experience exceeded our expectations. From the initial consultation to the scheduled installation, every step was meticulously handled with professionalism and care.Initial Consultation: The process began with a detailed consultation where the director took the time to understand our specific needs and preferences. They provided comprehensive information on the various battery storage options available, helping us make an informed decision on the size and type of system that would best suit our home solar system. Their expertise was evident, and we appreciated the thoroughness with which they explained the benefits and maintenance requirements of each option.Ongoing Communication: Throughout the entire process, the communication was impeccable. The team kept us informed about every stage of the project, from ordering the equipment to scheduling the installation. Regular updates ensured that we were always in the loop, and any questions or concerns we had were promptly addressed. This level of transparency and responsiveness was truly commendable.Installation Day: The scheduled installation day arrived, and the team sent message to us with their time frame, and arrived on time, ready to get to work. They were courteous, efficient, and clearly knowledgeable about their craft. The installation process was seamless, and they took great care to ensure that everything was done to the highest standard. They even went the extra mile to clean up after themselves, leaving our home in the same condition as when they arrived.Post-Installation Support: Even after the installation was complete, the support did not end. The team followed up to ensure that we were satisfied with the system and to answer any questions we had about its operation. Their dedication to customer satisfaction is truly unmatched.Overall, our experience with NG Energy Trade Solutions were nothing short of exceptional. Their attention to detail, professionalism, and genuine care for their customers make them a standout choice for anyone considering battery storage installation. We highly recommend their services and encourage others to experience the same level of excellence that we did. Thank you, NG Energy Trade Solutions , for making this process so smooth and enjoyable!

Very happy with the installation and would be happy to recommend them to friends and family. Quoting process was polite, punctual, and easy to follow. They were eager and able to answer all my questions. The installation was a bit more complicated than initially quoted but they were happy to honour the initial quoted price. The installation went much longer than expected due to the complicated wiring needed for my home but the team stayed behind and got the job done, working the whole day. After sales customer service was also very good and helped me to fix up some connectivity issues due to my own error.

I engaged Erol and NG Trade Solutions to replace an older solar system with a new, larger system which is battery ready and suitable for future/coming technologies. Erol made time to attend site and identify a suitable location for the inverter and gateway, discuss potential hardware options and work through any possible pinch points.Whilst a few options were discussed the choice was made to install 28 Aiko Solar 2p panels, a Sigenergy 10kw inverter and Sigenergy Gateway, with plans to add a 16kwh (now 24kwh) battery pending the battery rebate.His team arrived promptly, were friendly, professional and efficient. Any issues on the day were raised with potential solutions ready to be discussed. Installation was smooth and the quality of install was evident in the thorough inspection and verification of workmanship by the on-site supervisor. Any quality issues identified by the supervisor were discussed with the team and guidance provided to both rectify and avoid future recurrance which displays not only ownership but growth and development of the teams knowledge and skills.All of the necessary paperwork required for the network connection was organised in advance and they had my phone connected to the gateway within minutes of commissioning.I look forward to working with NG Trade Solutions in the near future for installation of a Sigenergy battery to complement the solar install.

The sales and quoting process was efficient and informative. The provided quote was clear and addressed all inquiries promptly.The installation process was conducted professionally. The installation team was observed to be polite and tidy throughout the work. They adhered to the agreed-upon schedule and commenced and completed the installation punctually.Customer service post-installation was satisfactory. The company facilitated the grid connection process and provided clear instructions on the operation of the installed system.

I had a fantastic experience with Energy Trade Solutions from start to finish. Corey and the installation team were exceptional, tidy, and extremely professional throughout the entire process. The quoting process was clear and helpful, thanks to Erol who was always available to assist, with his extensive product knowledge, honesty, and transparency which gave me the confidence to make informed decisions. I highly recommend NG to anyone seeking reliable and high-quality service.

The entire process was flawless—from the initial quote to installation and post-sales support. Alana and the team went above and beyond at every stage, working tirelessly to secure all the necessary approvals with our embedded network (which was no easy task!). They consistently provided updates and followed up with the energy company, ensuring everything stayed on track.The installation was for my rental property while I was overseas. When Corey called to confirm the inverter placement, the call dropped due to a bad connection. I messaged Alana, and she handled everything seamlessly. Their attention to detail is truly exceptional, and their commitment to customer service is unmatched.I cannot recommend them highly enough!

The NG team was fantastic from start to finish! Erol was always just a phone call away, responding promptly to my questions via text, email, or phone calls. His extensive product knowledge was evident as he clearly explained the differences between various systems without any pressure to upsell—just honest, helpful guidance to support my decision-making. Their pricing was competitive and transparent, with no hidden costs. The installation process was seamless, and I’m thrilled with how the final result looks. I highly recommend the NG team for solar or EV chargers. Keep up the great work!
Excellent and professional service, highly recommended for solar panels and battery installation

We can't rave more about Erol and the team at NG Trade who just installed our 13kw system with Aiko panels and Sungrow inverter. The responses were sound, quote was competitive and workmanship impeccable.  It's a maze when exploring Solar and NG Trade were the stand out! Extremely accurate Solar assumption in the quote (estimated 58kw/day in March and sure enough today (March) we generated exactly that. Well done.

From start to finish the team at NG provided exceptional service and an even better installation expereince.Even when design changes where required from the orignal quote the installer assisted us in providing all the available options to move forward with the build which was seemless and smooth process, oustanding work.Same with the quoting, i requested some changes in regards to layout and system and this was accomodated in timely and informative manner which was very welcomed at the time, as i had many different quotes all stating the same rhetoric which becoming tiresome. NG provided a welcome change, great work.Overrall very happy with initial quoting right down to the installation, exceeded our expectation on all fronts.

NG were exceptionally fast in responding to my request via Solar Quotes. Erol was more than happy to talk through all the options with me and the price quoted was very competitive.The install occurred a couple of weeks after signing the contract which I thought was very good. Everything was done for me so no need to contact my electrical provider. The guys arrived when they said they would, the work was very neat and tidy and done in less than a day.If you are looking at getting solar installed in the Brisbane/Toowoomba area then you need to talk with NG.

Out of a total of 14 quotes I chose NG Plumbing & Electrical, they didn’t seem pushy, happily worked through changes to the plans and quotes and offered what I believe was a fair price (after much deliberating on my part).They were very accomodating with scheduling an install date and the installation team were very tidy and respectful.I noticed a fair portion of very highly priced quotes and extremely low priced quotes, we ended up deciding on mid tier pricing at $725/kw being what I think is the sweet spot for the system we bought.NG Plumbing and Electrical - were one of the only installers that didn’t get caught up in stories about watching out for dodgy installers or pushing certain brands in order to try justify their price.This strategy was something I noticed a lot of installers used, I found it was very off putting and not very professional. So I always checked the quoted price against a first principles estimate on how much a system would cost (materials and labour) - making sure to do this comparison against full system cost before STC rebate.We are very happy with the quoting and install process through NG plumbing and electrical and so far we are happy with the performance of our system.

Received a response from my Solar Quotes request on the same day, site visit the next day.No pressure whatsoever for any particular product and we arrived at the best setup for my needs. I even changed up the battery size at the last minute and this was no issue.Installation was within a few days (I can't believe they actually worked on Christmas Eve). The guys worked all day to do the install, super nice and friendly with no mess. Even let my wife video how to use the system (brilliant!).Received a follow up call after Christmas to see how it was going and grid connection was done before new year.Process was made super simple, pricing was sharp, all the requests and paperwork were looked after for me.Can't be happier with the total experience and how the system is working.As a result, I have no hesitation in recommending NG Plumbing and Electrical Pty Ltd.In a time when we expect more and are usually underwhelmed by what we receive - these guys really exceeded all expectations. Well done!

NG Plumbing & Electrical did such an amazing job at getting my solar installed. We just moved into our new property and I had called around quite a few different places to look at getting solar installed. Erol was extremely pleasant to deal with, honest and did not hound me for my business. They were upfront and efficient. If anyone is wondering who to get solar with, I couldn't recommend NG enough!

The whole process from quoting to installation was done in a professional and efficient manner. The staff were courteous  and kept us informed every step of the way. We are very happy with the outcome and would not hesitate to recommend this company.

Very happy with the new solar panels and inverter installed by NG Plumbing & Electrical.Several proposals were provided by Erol for my consideration and explained in detail the components and projected savings over the life of the system to help me make an informed choice.  Lanie then organised a suitable time for removal of the old system and then installation of the new following roof restoration works in between.Dave, Corey and the team who performed the removal and installation were great to deal with and explained all of the works they would be doing and were happy to accommodate any requests.  The installation was very neat and site left clean and tidy.I would have no hesitation dealing with NG Plumbing & Electrical again and recommending them to others.

Review for Solar Panel Approval and InstallationI recently had solar panels installed, and I couldn’t be happier with the service from Lanie and Erol. From start to finish, the whole process was seamless.Approval Process:Lanie and Erol made the approval process easy, handling all the permits and paperwork. They kept me updated every step of the way and ensured everything was in line with local regulations.Installation:The installation was quick and professional. Erol and his team were punctual, friendly, and efficient, and they took the time to explain everything. They left the place spotless once the job was done.Performance:The system is working perfectly, and I’m confident I made the right choice.I highly recommend Lanie and Erol for anyone looking to go solar – their service is top-notch!

I found the arranging of quotes from NG, and the other companies I approached, to be very positive and informing. NG ensured they designed the product that met my needs and priced it accordingly. Despite the inclement weather, the installation was handled professionally and the installers were excellent. They were approachable and answered any questions I may have had and explained the process and implementation the me. I have no issue at all with their punctuality and tidiness  The after service was equally good. The BG office contacted me a number of times to ensure that I was happy with the the installation and that everything was working as it should. I did identify an issue and the NG installer came out promptly and rectified the issue. I have been very impressed with NGs service and the attitude of its staff. I have also been very impressed with the performance of the hardware. Despite days of rainy weather, the panels were able to produce sufficient energy to meet our needs and top up the battery. I haven't had to rely on the grid for the past three days. Now the sun is shining, I expect to see an even more impressive result.

It took me a while to make a decision as to what was the system which suite me in terms of price and hardware and NG Plumbing and Electrical gave me every assistance possible for me to come to a decision.When I did finally decide the installation went without hitch, not helped I am sure by some drizzly rain, everything cleaned up and a nice tidy job.I have no hesitation in recommending NG Plumbing and Electrical.We are waiting for the meter connections to be finished.

They did an amazing job! Very timely, excellent communication, straight to the point, the quote was spot on, very detailed and easy to read and understand.They did absolutely everything, I didn’t have to lift a finger. Connection is perfect and easy to understand. They were extremely polite and very tidy. Very fast with communication and explanations. Will be using them for all my electrical needs from now on.
The entire experience with NG Plumbing and Electrical went smoothly.From sales to installation the team did a fantastic job. Communication was fantastic.

The quoting process was very straightforward, there was some back and forwarding in regards to brands of solar panels and which inverter would be best for my purposes, none of this was a problem for them.The installation went really well, they turned up on time, two guys, very professional and experienced, they explained what they were doing, they listened to me (in regards location of the inverter, etc) and kept the work site clean and tidy throughout the day.They spent time at the end of the install to give me some instructions on how everything worked, etc.Customer service has been excellent, there were some forms to sign, all done electronically, the office lady has rung a couple of times to follow up after the install to ensure grid connection is occurring, etc.The owner of the company has been in touch as well, to ensure I am happy with everything and to check the install went well (which it did).I am very happy with this company, and highly recommend them to anyone considering using them.

Erol explained everything really well during the quoting stage, and answered all my questions.The team at NG were friendly and professional and did a grea job of our Solar install.They went above and beyond our expectations.  Even disposing of the old tall TV aerial and chimney pope that they removed for us during the install.In a market that is flooded with operators, I felt that I could trust Erol and his business and was not disappointed.  I would highly recommend them as a solar installer.In the event that we need plumbing or electrical work in the future I would also get them to quote for us.Thanks NG Team.  We are happy customers.
Fast comprehensive quote, fast service and installation. easy to understand options and choices.

Working with NG Plumbing and Electrical Pty Ltd was a fantastic experience. From the quoting process to a quality and good looking installation of the solar panels, the wiring, the hybrid inverter and battery. The knowledge and experience with guiding us to get the correct system and getting a professional installation was great. The customer service was exemplary and communication easy and comfortable. The installers were very well experienced, they arrived on time and were very efficient. They cleaned the whole site up nicely after the installation, were friendly, and the whole system looks awesome. Installing the monitoring app was easy and works nicely.I highly recommend NG Plumbing and Electrical Pty Ltd for any solar and battery installation.Fred

The quoting process wad very straightforward and simple with multiple options given to suit budgets. We chose the most preferred option that suited the size and what we were looking for in our budget. The customer service we received from answering questions to quick responses were the absolute best! This company values their clients! Our installers were punctual, professional and did a wonderful job. We were given all the information we required to use our system efficiently

I recently had a solar system installed by NG Plumbing % Electrical, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. From start to finish, from obtaining a quote to installation,  the team was punctual, friendly, and incredibly informative. They answered all my questions with patience and made the entire process seamless. It’s clear that they take pride in their work and care about their customers. Highly recommend their services for anyone considering solar installation!

Erol and the team at NG were professional and efficient.It took less than 1 week from giving a quote to have the system fully installed.I believe Erol and the team at NG have work really hard to provide great services to consumers. I would recommend Erol and team at NG for their work.
